sections.description: StageKit WP Media provides a high-performance, non-attachment media asset management system with virtual/nested folder hierarchy, drag-and-drop uploads, responsive thumbnail generation, storage diagnostics, and direct cloud sync with Google Drive, Google Photos, Dropbox, Pexels, Unsplash, Flickr, YouTube, and Vimeo.
sections.installation: Upload the stagekitwp-media plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/, activate it, and open the StageKit Media Library in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.changelog: See the plugin repository for release notes and updates.

name: stagekitwp-media
author: Huw Evans
short_description: Dedicated media asset manager, hierarchical folder organization, isolated storage outside core WordPress media, and cloud sync galleries.
